note: The priest, who has stood at the altar of every chapel in this world drawn as a shopkeeper.

A cassock rather than trousers, which is one colour from the knee up and reads from any angle as somebody who is not dressed like the rest of the street. The stole over the shoulders is the second half of it and the part that survives being seen from directly above.

parts.note: the cassock: a skirt over the legs from the waist down, so the walk shows beneath it
and the stole, two bands over the shoulders — the one bit of a priest visible from straight above
